text:
noah: Quick pulse  planning a short demo workshop (Jun 30). Goal: test tiny credit incentives + tailored prompt snippets to boost first-success within 7 days. Need a compact experiment and routing plan.

anya: Proposed matrix:
- Control: follow-up doc only
- Arm 1: persona-specific prompt pack only
- Arm 2: prompt pack + 30 starter credits + email nudge at 24h
- Arm 3: prompt pack + 60 credits + one-click 'claim' on landing + 48h in-app toast
Hypothesis: Arm 2 is most cost-efficient; Arm 3 gives highest raw lift.

sam: Metrics to track: registered, attended, pack_downloaded, credits_granted, credits_redeemed, first_success_call, active_7d, tokens_first_week. Include cohort_id, persona, preferred_model on all events.

mira: UX notes: landing form should collect persona (Product/Data/Platform) and optional 'claim credits now' checkbox. Routing rules: persona -> respective nurture stream; add cohort tag with experiment arm. If dedicated pool is saturated, fallback to hosted and log fallback_model.

noah: Ops constraints: campaign credit cap $7k. Auto-stop on cap hit; notify #finance at 75% and 90%. Per-user cap: 100 credits. Credits TTL: 14 days.

anya: Quick dev snippet for registration webhook (paste as text in the doc):
- endpoint: POST /marketing/inbound
- payload fields: event, email, persona, cohort_id, preferred_model, fallback_model, utm_campaign
Example placeholder line: event=workshop_reg&email={{email}}&persona=product&cohort_id=jun30-arm2

sam: UX experiment idea: show a temporary header CTA "Use your starter credits" for 5 days vs none on 30% of arms with credits. Run small subset to control budget.

mira: Instrumentation owner: mira. Prompt pack owner: sam. Copy + landing: anya. Ops: implement cap enforcement + alerting. Deadline: EOD Tue. Quick check-in tomorrow 11am?

ops-bot: Calendar event created: jun30-workshop. Reminders: 48h, 2h, 15m.

noah: Also want a single slide micro-benchmark for the landing: before vs after (avg tokens/query, est $/session). Keep numbers illustrative until pilot runs. Let's keep this lean and ship the test.
